You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.   The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. candidates.title: STEUART NUTRITION: Software Developer AI Coding
candidates.description: Headquarters: Minnesota URL: https://www.steuartnutrition.com/ About us Steuart Nutrition is a GMP-certified contract manufacturer making powders, liquids, capsules and stick packs for growing wellness brands. We run on Extreme Ownership, clear communication and fast turnaround, and we want a developer who works the same way. The role We're hiring a remote developer to own the customization of our training app. You'll learn the platform quickly, then build what our teams need to train and onboard people. Over time you'll also take on other internal tools and automations. AI-assisted development is central to how we work, so we want someone who uses AI tools to write and ship better code faster. What you'll do Learn our training app inside and out, then customize and extend it Build features, integrations and automations with AI coding tools like Claude, Cursor, Copilot and Grok Turn rough requests from the plant and office teams into working solutions Document your work so others can use it and maintain it Give regular, clear progress updates What we're looking for 3+ years of professional software development Strong, proven skill with AI-assisted coding: you know how to prompt, check and fix AI-generated code A track record of quickly learning unfamiliar platforms and codebases Experience with APIs, web apps and integrations (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred) Excellent written English and consistent communication Able to overlap at least 4 hours a day with US Easter
